items.snippet: [히트뉴스=방혜림 기자] 비만치료제로 주목받아 온 한국릴리의 '마운자로(성분명 터제파타이드)'가 제2형 당뇨병 치료 영역에서 보폭을 넓히고 있다. 심혈관계 질환을 동반한 성인 제2형 당뇨병 환자의 주요 심혈관계 사건 발생 위험 감소와 소아청소년 제2형 당뇨병 치료로 적응증을 확대한데 따른 전망이다. 혈당과 체중 조절을 넘어 당뇨병 합병증 관리와 기존 치료제의 미충족 의료 수요 해소에 기여할지 주목된다.한국릴리는 24일 마운자로의 심혈관계 위험 감소 및 소아청소년 제2형 당뇨병 치료 적응증 허가 확대를 계기로 기자간담회를 열고 주요

items.snippet: [히트뉴스=김선경 기자] 넥스아이(대표 윤경완)는 항체약물접합체(ADC) 파이프라인 'NXI-S301'이 국가신약개발사업단(KDDF·단장 박영민)이 주관하는 '2026년도 제2차 국가신약개발사업' 신규 지원과제로 선정됐다고 24일 밝혔다.이번 과제는 '신약 기반 확충 연구'의 선도물질 분야에 해당한다. 넥스아이는 이번 과제를 통해 NXI-S301의 연구개발을 진행하고 후속 후보물질 확보에 필요한 연구를 수행할 계획이다.국가신약개발사업은 국내 제약·바이오산업의 글로벌 경쟁력 강화를 목표로 하는 범부처 국가 연구개발(R&D) 사업이다.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Study of Tersolisib (LY4064809/STX-478) With Other Anti-Cancer Treatments in Participants With Advanced Breast Cancer With a Genetic Change (PIK3CA) (Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT07174336 | Sponsor: Eli Lilly and Company | Condition: Breast Neoplasms, Neoplasm Metastasis | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. The purpose of the study is to assess the efficacy and safety of the addition of Tersolisib (LY4064809/STX-478) to other anti-cancer drugs as first treatment for advanced hormone receptor-positive (HR+)/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-) breast cancer. Participants can remain in the study as long as the drug is helping the cancer without unbearable side effects.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] An Extension Study to Investigate the Long-term Safety and Tolerability of Itepekimab in Adult Participants With Inadequately Controlled Chronic Rhinosinusitis With Nasal Polyps (Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)
items.snippet:
NCT ID: NCT07424144 | Sponsor: Sanofi | Condition: Chronic Rhinosinusitis With Nasal Polyps | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. This is a double-blind, parallel-group, Phase 3, 2-arm study that is designed to provide additional safety information, assess the durability of treatment response, and provide additional PK and immunogenicity assessments.

The primary purpose of this study is to evaluate safety and tolerability of both new or continued treatment with itepekimab 300 mg SC high dose or itepekimab 300 mg SC low dose

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Isatuximab in Combination With Novel Agents in RRMM - Master Protocol (Phase 1/Phase 2, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT04643002 | Sponsor: Sanofi | Condition: Plasma Cell Myeloma Refractory | Phase: Phase 1/Phase 2 | Status: RECRUITING. The purpose of this umbrella study is to evaluate isatuximab when combined with novel agents with or without dexamethasone in participants with relapsed or refractory myeloma. Substudy 01 is the control Substudy. Substudies 02, 03, and 06 are controlled experimental substudies. Substudies 04 and 05 are independent experimental substudies.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] LY4268989 in Adults With Moderately to Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis (Phase 2, RECRUITING)
items.snippet:
NCT ID: NCT07415044 | Sponsor: Eli Lilly and Company | Condition: Ulcerative Colitis (UC), Ulcerative Colitis, Active Moderate, Ulcerative Colitis, Active Severe | Phase: Phase 2 | Status: RECRUITING. The main purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of LY4268989 when compared to placebo in adult participants with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC). The study drug will be administered orally.

The study will last up to approximately 108 weeks, excluding screening.
